output.reason: [ev-4e7b065b85d5] only says the legacy `--log_rotate_*` flags were removed and that users should switch to external log rotation tools. It does not say what happens to a component that still gets these flags. The flags could be silently ignored (setting-ignored), or the component could reject them as unknown and fail to start (workload-failure). Nothing in the surrounding installation section, and no upgrade-guide text, settles which, so "setting-ignored" and its statement that the flags are "no longer recognized or honored" go beyond the evidence. Deciding this needs upstream text or an artifact showing how the components handle an unknown or removed `--log_rotate_*` flag, and which components accepted these flags.
